values: FZP1 is a compact binary-file parser used to compare black-box and white-box fuzzing. A file contains a four-byte magic value, one-byte payload length, payload, and one-byte XOR checksum. The vulnerable parser copies a validated payload into a 16-byte stack buffer; the fixed parser rejects payloads longer than 16 bytes.
